exhaustive_note: EXHAUSTIVE. Every triple (lam,mu,nu) with nu a partition of exactly 6 positive parts and |nu| <= 22, |lam|+|mu| = |nu|, was generated. Empty (c=0) triples are excluded by the Littlewood-Richardson containment necessary condition (control below). Symmetric duplicates lam<->mu are collapsed (identical polytope). Every one of the 697,963 non-empty triples received the full mandated LP-free screen; all 84 engine-A node-cap skips were resolved exactly with engine B (see cap_resolution). Zero unresolved skips remain.

non_lattice_diagnostic.note: hive_poly.py exact vertices (Fraction, each verified against every rhombus inequality); maxden>=2 is a RIGOROUS non-lattice certificate. 203/2023 sampled hive polytopes are certified non-lattice (half- and third-integral vertices) yet ALL obey h*_d <= h*_1. The population is genuinely rational; it simply does not (in this range) escape the lattice inequality. maxden==1 on a sampled vertex is not a proof of integrality, so 203 is a one-sided LOWER bound. Diagnostic only; never a filter.
